input_source.source_interpretation: Documented nestling-origin adult first-year resighting at different study island, NOT all true immigrants or net demographic rescue

immutable_eras.training_birth_years: 1994–2013 historical aggregated, n=259 recorded moved IDs
immutable_eras.independences: Only chronological different birth cohorts, NOT independent island systems, field effort or experiments

reference_models.destination_popularity: For each candidate receiving island j other than source i, P0(j|i)=(historic_total_arrivals_to_j+1)/(sum_k!=i historic_total_arrivals_to_k + 10) ; fixed Laplace pseudo-count α=1 per allowed target
reference_models.symmetric_pair: For source i and target j, U_ij=historic_i_to_j + historic_j_to_i. R1(j|i)=(U_ij + tau*P0(j|i))/(sum_k!=i U_ik+tau), tau=10
reference_models.impossible_self_moves: P0(i|i)=R1(i|i)=C(i|i)=0; 10 allowed destinations for each origin
reference_models.terminal_score: Mean negative log probability of actual observed destination j, conditioned on known natal source i, using 173 later moved IDs; lower better
reference_models.primary: C-R1 later heldout log loss: negative means directional orientation beyond symmetric pair topology, positive is adverse
reference_models.secondary: R1-P0 later heldout log loss for undirected historical link versus destination popularity
reference_models.sensitivities: Replay all three models with tau=5 and tau=20 in addition to primary 10, fixed before scoring; do NOT select best tau
reference_models.supplementary: Per-donor 11-island heldout score changes, equal-weight across represented donor islands vs weighted per-arrival, unseen historical routes in future births; no posthoc island or cohort selection

stop_and_claim_guards.if_C_minus_R1_positive: report non-support, do not rescue through tau or selected islands
stop_and_claim_guards.if_C_minus_R1_negative: retrospective out-of-time prediction of observed migrant destinations only, already studied in earlier Ranke et al 2021
